parsed.post: The attempt to scale DEPTH to 6 resulted in 1.027319, which is worse than our current best (1.009912). It seems the higher capacity model needs more training time or a more aggressive learning rate to converge within the 5-minute window. Reverting to 3734fbf.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.1 to accelerate convergence for the DEPTH=6 model, aiming to capture more capacity gains within the fixed 5-minute budget.
